selection: Training macro Dice only; report validation without selecting on it

recipes.nnunet: Keep native Dice+CE, SGD0.01, hold-half schedule; new shared3x cap gives more room than failed1.5x.
recipes.swinunetr: Keep all-class logarithmic squared Dice and AdamW; introduce pairedxy_d4_v1 augmentation to reduce training memorization.
recipes.unetr_vit_b16: Keep Geo Dice+CE, pairedD4, dropout and peakLR; test hold-half decay instead of immediate post-warmup cosine to improve learning within lower cap.
recipes.basic_unet16: Keep original Dice and AdamW; introduce pairedxy_d4_v1 augmentation to reduce training memorization.

rationale: Budget-only pilots show undertrained nnUNet/UNETR while Swin/UNet still exceed target. Recipe changes are a separate experimental condition, never overwritten into the prior baseline result.
pending_user_preference: Adjust recipes at lower sharedcap versus budget-only changes with unequal training Dice
